evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index sits at 20 (Extreme Fear) on 2025-11-25, continuing an extended multi-week period of depressed sentiment where the 7-day average fell to 14.71 and the 30-day mean was 24.07. limitations: Fear & Greed Index is a composite daily sentiment indicator and does not directly capture intraday order book liquidity or spot volume dynamics.
Extreme fear conditions can persist during strong structural downtrends, limiting contrarian predictability over short 24-hour windows.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
